summary: Join our specialized training on managing counterparty credit risk. Learn essential techniques and best practices to safeguard your financial transactions.
lede: Counterparty credit risk management involves measuring potential exposure when a trading counterparty defaults before a transaction is settled. Designed for financial risk, collateral and trading professionals, the course addresses the practical work of tracking and mitigating exposures across derivatives and banking books. Learners work with potential future exposure profiles, margin and collateral processes, CVA and DVA adjustments, wrong-way risk, and SA-CCR capital calculations.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for financial professionals who bear direct responsibility for measuring, mitigating, and reporting counterparty exposures across trading and banking books.
modules: Central Clearing and CCP Risk Management
CCR Limit Frameworks and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of OTC derivatives (swaps, options, forwards) and basic credit risk concepts. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling and data analysis. Familiarity with general banking regulatory frameworks (Basel III) is highly recommended. No advanced programming experience is required; complex quantitative models will be explored using pre-built templates and operational frameworks.
